ai-native.canonical_definition: AI-native community slang: agents, prompts, LLMs, model talk.
ai-native.downstream_use: AI-native attractor historically dominated Stage B.
ai-native.exclusions: Generic computing without AI sense; sci-fi 'android' without AI-native register.
ai-native.note: Subtype of technology domain; should not be a flat sibling of technology-ai.

betting-sharp.canonical_definition: Gambling/betting market language (odds, vig, spreads, bookmakers).
betting-sharp.exclusions: Metaphorical 'bet' as stance without market; crypto staking without wager framing.

conflict-aggression.canonical_definition: Conflictive/aggressive force: violence, combat, hostility framing.
conflict-aggression.exclusions: Metaphorical 'fight' for sports/competition without hostility sense.

crypto-degen.exclusions: Generic 'token' in NLP; ordinary finance without crypto.

gaming-meta.canonical_definition: Competitive/multiplayer game discourse: balance, meta, skill asymmetry, match-end status speech tied to play.
gaming-meta.downstream_use: Route gaming slang lineage / virality analysis.
gaming-meta.exclusions: Generic 'player' without game sense; sports athletes; AI agents.
gaming-meta.positive_inclusion: Text encodes game-play / gamer-community lexical evidence.

identity-affiliation.downstream_use: Identity tracking; high confusion with evaluation.
identity-affiliation.exclusions: Evaluative slurs without affiliation sense; mere demonym geography.
identity-affiliation.note: Often CONTEXT_DEPENDENT or overlaps evaluative/political axes; needs redefinition or multi-label mapping, not flat exclusive bucket.

internet-slang.downstream_use: Historically a catch-all; overlaps almost every domain.
internet-slang.exclusions: Domain content that merely appears online; offline slang.
internet-slang.note: Register/mediation label, not a mutually exclusive domain family.

memetic.canonical_definition: Meme formats, macros, copypasta, template-driven viral form.
memetic.exclusions: Any viral topic without memetic form; political content alone.

music-entertainment.exclusions: Generic 'performance' in computing; fashion runway alone.

politics-civic.exclusions: Generic conflict/war without civic framing; sports 'left wing'.

regional-cultural.downstream_use: Often annotation metadata, not a content family.
regional-cultural.exclusions: Topic about a place without variety marking; demonyms as identity.
regional-cultural.note: Variety marking is frequently CONTEXT_DEPENDENT or dictionary-label metadata; weak as a mutually exclusive Stage-B family.
regional-cultural.positive_inclusion: Explicit dialect/region variety evidence in text.

relationship-dating.exclusions: Platonic affiliation; workplace 'partner'; evaluative insult alone.

social-evaluation.canonical_definition: Evaluative stance and status judgment: praise, insult, pejoration, prestige/hierarchy labeling (merge of approval-disapproval + social-status).
social-evaluation.exclusions: Neutral description without stance; pure demonym without evaluation.
social-evaluation.positive_inclusion: Evaluative or status-hierarchy lexical evidence in text.

spiritual-mystic.canonical_definition: Occult, astrology, esoteric, spiritual practice discourse.
spiritual-mystic.exclusions: Metaphorical 'magic' in tech/gaming without spiritual sense.

technology-ai.exclusions: AI-community slang that is specifically model/agent discourse (ai-native).
technology-ai.note: Overlaps ai-native; hierarchical parent of AI-discourse subtype.

preferred_ontology.rationale: Geometry (between>within), retrieval non-viability, and 152 review pairs are consistent with overlapping dimensions forced into exclusive buckets. Separating DOMAIN × FUNCTION × MEDIATION with hierarchy for AI⊂technology is the smallest structure that preserves useful distinctions without unstable exclusive boundaries. Flat reduction alone cannot express legitimate co-occurrence (e.g., sports+gambling, gaming+conflict, politics+memetic).

qualification_consequence.reason: QUAL uses the historical exclusive family schema. Hierarchical multi-label cannot be metadata-only migrated without reading/resettling gold. Keep seal; do not compromise holdout now.

semantic_level_diagnosis.diagnosis: The flat 18-way ontology conflates DOMAIN aboutness (gaming/crypto/sports/…), SEMANTIC_RELATION (relationship/identity), and PRAGMATIC_FUNCTION (evaluation/memetic/internet-register/conflict). A single mutually exclusive Stage-B head cannot represent this.

stage_a_consequence.default: Stage A remains a logically separate evidence/relation gate (EVIDENCE_PRESENT / NO_EVIDENCE / UNCERTAIN) before Stage B labeling.
stage_a_consequence.interaction: Ontology revision changes what Stage B emits after PRESENT, not the definition of evidence sufficiency. No Stage A reopen without new evidence.

alternatives_rejected.HIERARCHICAL_SINGLE_LABEL: Hierarchy helps AI⊂tech but not multi-aspect text
alternatives_rejected.RETRIEVAL_PLUS_VERIFICATION: May be a later architecture; not the ontology/task definition itself

annotation_disagreement.meaning: Human raters disagree; hold out from definitive training gold

insufficient_context.meaning: Text underdetermined for definitive labels (Stage A UNCERTAIN / CONTEXT_DEPENDENT)

multi_label_co_occurrence.meaning: Multiple V6 labels simultaneously true; not uncertain

ontology_ambiguity.meaning: Text fits multiple exclusive historical buckets; needs resettlement under new ontology
